scripts.title: Give All Items
scripts.script:
getgenv().Amount = 1000000

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local EReplication = ReplicatedStorage.ClientToServer.DataEvents.EReplication
local ClaimItem = ReplicatedStorage.LocalReplicated.Items.ClaimItem

local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ItemDescriptions).Items

for i = 1,50 do
    task.wait()
    EReplication:FireServer("secret","LuckyChest",vector.create(0,0,0))
end

ClaimItem:FireServer("MaterialOrb")
ClaimItem:FireServer("MaterialOrbClaim","MaterialOrb",10000)

for i,_ in Items do
    task.wait()
    ClaimItem:FireServer("MaterialOrb")
    ClaimItem:FireServer("MaterialOrbClaim",i,getgenv().Amount)
end
scripts.features:
Gives how ever much you want of all items in the game
change getgenv().Amount value to however much you want of all items
